name: malo-browser
description: Agent browser runtime and scripted web demo tool: a daemon hands out port leases with isolated, profile-backed browser sessions that agents drive through 27 session tools (snapshots with iframe content, typed input, login handoff, network capture), plus a visible Electron stage, hidden 1080p30 recording with evidence files, a director console and a loopback control API.

interface.shortDescription: An agent browser runtime with a scripted demo tool
interface.longDescription: Malo Browser is an agent browser runtime: its daemon hands out loopback port leases, each lease hosts isolated, profile-backed browser sessions with persistent login state, and agents drive them through 27 session tools - structured snapshots with iframe content, clicks, typed input, assertions, login handoff windows and network capture. The same app runs a scripted Electron stage for live web demos with hidden 1920x1080@30fps recording, evidence files, a director console and a loopback control API.
